name: Moped
description: A motorized device on no more than three wheels with an electric motor, or a liquid-fuel motor of 50 cc or less, producing no more than two gross brake horsepower (1,500 W) and able to propel it no faster than 30 mph on level ground. Defined by Revised Code of Washington §46.04.304; ESSB 6110 (Chapter 159, Laws of 2026) notes this definition covers many vehicles its narrower e-bike definition excludes.

restrictions.rule: No more than three wheels on the ground; pedals aren't required
Its motor produces no more than two gross brake horsepower (1,500 W) and can propel it no faster than 30 mph on level ground
Not a motorcycle, motor-driven cycle or electric-assisted bicycle
Riders must be 16 or older with a valid driver's license of any class; no motorcycle endorsement or special exam
Every rider and passenger must wear a motorcycle helmet on a state highway, county road or city street
The operator must wear glasses, goggles or a face shield unless it has a windshield, and it needs mirrors on both sides
Registered with a moped registration number and plate, and exempt from personal property and vehicle excise taxes
Exempt from the liability insurance requirement
Never allowed on a fully controlled limited access highway, a sidewalk, a bicycle path or trail, bikeway, or equestrian, hiking or recreational trail
Its muffler or pollution control device may not be removed
